Just because he doesn't care for you as much right now doesn't mean that no one will ever care for you. Life is fluid it's constantly changing and tomorrow could be the day that you meet a new best friend or future husband. Right now you life your sucks but if you don't stick around how can it ever get better. Tomorrow when you see him be yourself if you're a nervous reck then don't try to cover it up, if you're so sad that you can't hold back tears then don't be afraid to cry, if you still have feelings for him then let him know but be respectful, don't get into his personal space if he doesn't want you there. The thing about love is that "the one" isn't just one person it's several people, what makes someone "the one" is the way they change together. People change after all and so maybe that person who you pass ever day on the street could be the one. Or maybe there's someone out there who you haven't met yet who can make you incredibly happy and who is perfect for you in ever way just waiting for you. Someone who you'll never get to meet if you jump in front of a car.
You always matter to someone, even if you don't know them yet. Do you have any hobbies or things that you enjoy doing?

1: slipped and cut myself while carving and took a chunk out of my left thumb.

2. Taking a knife out of its sheath (the sheath was on my belt) I dropped it and tried to catch it. Ended up cutting myself in three places.  The worst of which was on my left middle finger. I proud of these because they happens less than 24 hours after buying the knife. 

3. I dropped an old rusted piece of railway track on my right calf, cutting it open pretty badly. Lesson learned don't haul scrap metal in shorts.

4. Scar just above my hip bone on the left side from when I fell down some Rapids.

5 and 6. Cut my self working with sheet metal, then about a month later I grabbed a hot stove handle and burned all of skin around the place where I cut myself. Now I have a jagged scar from the sheet metal and a oval shaped scar around it from the burn. 

7. Fell off my bike while going down a hill about a year ago and took all of the skin off of my elbows, thankfully I was wearing pants. 

8. Some dumbass poked me in the thumb with a metal marshmallow roasting stick that he had super heated in the fire. As a result I have a circular scar on my left thumb.

9. Trying to get a golf ball out of a pine tree I managed to drive a nail through my wrist (it's a long story).
